input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email template likely hardcodes the URL to `localhost:3000`, causing the link in the email to point to a non-routable address. This is a bug in the email template generation logic, not the auth logic itself.

input.title: Fix password reset email to use the correct domain instead of localhost
input.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email currently generates a link pointing to `http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=...`, which is incorrect for users outside the development environment. The link should use the configured domain (e.g., the production or staging URL) instead of `localhost`. This change ensures that users receive functional reset links in their emails, resolving the issue where the link does not load for external users.

input.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email currently generates a link pointing to `http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=...`, which is incorrect for users outside the development environment. The link should use the configured domain (e.g., the production or staging URL) instead of `localhost`. This change ensures that users receive functional reset links in their emails, resolving the issue where the link does not load for external users.
